Light Spring vs Light Summer

Light Spring and Light Summer are neighbouring colour seasons. They share the same depth. The difference is undertone: Light Spring is warm-neutral, Light Summer is cool-neutral; contrast: Light Spring is medium-low, Light Summer is low; chroma: Light Spring is clear, Light Summer is soft-medium.

Questions

What is the difference between Light Spring and Light Summer?

Light Spring and Light Summer are neighbouring colour seasons. They share the same depth. The difference is undertone: Light Spring is warm-neutral, Light Summer is cool-neutral; contrast: Light Spring is medium-low, Light Summer is low; chroma: Light Spring is clear, Light Summer is soft-medium.

Can I be between Light Spring and Light Summer?

Yes. Neighbouring seasons share a lot, and many people sit near the border. That's why Season Card shows your closest season and a runner-up.

How do I tell if I'm Light Spring or Light Summer?

Focus on undertone and contrast and chroma. In daylight, compare a colour from each palette under your chin, for example peach blossom (Light Spring) and powder pink (Light Summer), and see which makes your skin look more even.
